Signed-off-by: Peng Guanwen <pg999w@outlook.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #28717 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

Implement the new rawkv backup interface of HDFS.

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [RFC: RawKV Batch Export](https://github.com/tikv/rfcs/pull/76) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:

A new HDFS backend is added. The read/write operation is implemented by calling external hdfs binary in `$HADOOP_HOME` (Same as TiKV, See the RFC).

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

```release-note
br: support rawkv backup to hdfs backend.
```
